name: binhex-code-server
description: Code-server is a Visual Studio Code instance running on a remote server accessible through any web browser. It allows you to code anywhere and on any device such as a tablet or laptop with a consistent integrated development environment (IDE). Set up a secure a Linux development machine and get coding on any device with a web browser. Take advantage of a cloud server by offloading the system demanding tasks such as tests, compilations, downloads to another machine. Preserve battery life when you’re on the go or spend your downtime doing something else while the computationally intensive processes are running on your cloud server.

paths.name: Path: /config
paths.description: This is the container path to your configuration files, e.g. databases, configuration files, logs etc.

paths.name: Path: /data
paths.description: This is the container path to your downloaded files or user created content.

ports.name: Port: Web Interface
ports.description: This is the Web UI port for for the application.

variables.name: Variable: CERT_PATH
variables.description: Specify the path to the certificate used for SSL/TLS.

variables.name: Variable: CERT_KEY_PATH
variables.description: Specify the path to the certificate key used for SSL/TLS.

variables.name: Variable: SELF_SIGNED_CERT
variables.description: Specify whether to use a self-signed certificate.

variables.name: Variable: BIND_CLOUD_NAME
variables.description: Specify the bind cloud name used for SSL/TLS.

variables.name: Variable: ENABLE_STARTUP_SCRIPTS
variables.description: Specify whether to run startup scripts to install and/or configure additional applications.

variables.name: Variable: PASSWORD
variables.description: Specify the password used to access the Web UI.

variables.name: Variable: HEALTHCHECK_COMMAND
variables.description: The command or script to execute, if not specified then the script healthcheck.sh will be used (process, dns and https checking).

variables.name: Variable: HEALTHCHECK_ACTION
variables.description: The action to execute if the healthcheck command returns a non zero exit code, if not specified the action will be 'exit 1', if you want the container to exit on failure then set the action to 'kill 1'.

variables.name: Variable: HEALTHCHECK_HOSTNAME
variables.description: The hostname used when performing HTTPS and DNS healthchecking.

variables.name: Variable: PUID
variables.description: User ID for the running container

variables.name: Variable: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for the running container
